text: Maaku an Muhammadu: "E yo mi humpitu on ko ɓuri ɗin tuuyooji moƴƴude?". Hino woodani ɓen huluɓe Alla, ɓe ɗoftii Mo, ɓe haɗitii yeddugol Mo, Aljannaaji: hino ila senngo ley kuɓeeje e leɗɗe majji, canɗi; ko ɓe luttiŋteeɓe ton, ko aldaa e maayde maa mulugol, hino woodani ton rewɓe laɓɓinaaɓe jikku e tagudi e kala bone, hino woodani ɓe kadi yarluyee Alla on jippotooɗo e maɓɓe, O Tikkaŋtaaɓe poomaa. Alla ko Reŋtuɗo fiyakuuji jeyaaɓe Makko ɓen, hunnde e majji suuɗaaki, O Yoɓitiroyayɓe ɗum.
